metadata.title: Does the paraphrase refit hold at scale?

prereg.question: Does iteration 3's paraphrase-refit improvement of our AMS reimplementation (rho 0.358 -> 0.654 on 19 members / 7 lineages) hold on a panel grown to >= 20 weight lineages, and does it reproduce under ...
prereg.primary_estimator: rho = Spearman(score, y_refusal) at the MEMBER level with a LINEAGE-CLUSTERED bootstrap (10,000 replicates, lineages resampled with replacement, all their members taken). This is the estimator under w...
prereg.secondary_estimator: rho over LINEAGE-AGGREGATED units (per-lineage mean of member scores vs per-lineage mean of y). BOTH are reported for every score.
prereg.primary_score_definition: AMS aggregate sigma over the 0.40-0.80 relative-depth band (ams['sigma']).
prereg.robustness_correction: Holm across the robustness family; reported as a secondary family, never the headline.
prereg.auc_definition: AUC is reported two ways and enters NO decision rule. (i) the FROZEN iteration-3 statsx.auc_binary, which binarises y at its MEDIAN -- kept because it is the definition iteration 3's numbers were comp...

outcome_statistics.a_Delta_A: rho(sigma_refit_setA, y) - rho(sigma_original, y), PAIRED lineage bootstrap (the SAME resample recomputes BOTH rhos), 10,000 replicates, 95% percentile CI.
outcome_statistics.b_verdict_class_change_rate: fraction of members whose PASS/WARN/CRIT class differs between original and refit, with a Wilson CI, against the archived 6/19 = 0.316. DESCRIPTIVE, never a gate.
outcome_statistics.c_permutation_p_for_Delta_A: permute the LINEAGE labels attached to y and recompute BOTH rhos on every draw. n_lineage <= 8 -> exhaustive (floor 1/n_lineage!); otherwise Monte Carlo with 200,000 draws plus the identity, floor 1/2...
outcome_statistics.d_Delta_B_and_cross_set_rho: Delta_B identical to (a) but for paraphrase SET B, plus Spearman(sigma_refit_A, sigma_refit_B) across members -- the 'not a lucky wording' statistic.

decision_rule.descriptive_only: Statistic (b), the verdict-class change rate, is DESCRIPTIVE and is never a gate.
